classes.description: Coherent structural parts in observed views, no specific placement defect. Minor generic shader/seam fidelity limits alone belong here. Does not establish all-angle or native-game equivalence.
Caption explicitly describes a native cabless trailer, flatbed or separate partial vehicle model with aligned parts; absence of cab is intentional source scope.

A specific authored native accessory or resting pose remains uncertain (roof light, raised garbage lifting frame, cone/bumper/ladder), requiring source/runtime interpretation; no definitive exporter-caused placement defect established.
Specific unresolved visible clipping, overlapping or jagged rendering defect remains, even if broad assembly is coherent; takes precedence over no_clear issue.
Caption explicitly establishes detached or wrongly situated structural part such as floating wheel or door; not only material seams.

items.text: Fresh final public S7 source rear-quarter and rotated front-quarter images show the body shell, doors, roof, wheels and skirts seated. Compared with the prior original S7, broad white fin slabs and staircase-like protrusions are reduced to thin intake divider edges. Fine short gray fin endpoints remain visible near the lower rocker opening; native main-shell and blackmatte cavity surfaces remain gray behind the upper intake. Independent no-fin ownership and native identity-frame probes locate those cavity walls in the same skirts0 resource, rather than a separately misplaced attachment. The cleanup deliberately thins all ten fin groups; exact indices/topology/Y spans/welded copies are retained. Native surface contacts and game shader fidelity are unestablished, and no zero-contact/all-angle guarantee is claimed.

args.purpose: Triage only the newly changed S7 final public source preview after geometry cleanup; retain original judgments for the other105 unchanged model assets.
args.context: Host inspected both full final public S7 source PNGs and all212 source views. Small finite fin endpoints/native cavity walls are retained limitations, not evidence by themselves of a detached attachment or conspicuous remaining broad slab. Do not infer all-angle, zero-contact, or native game fidelity from no_clear classification.
